Steam Controller Review - Simply Better than Anything Else

The steam controller is really good. The touch pad can be jarring the first few times, but continue playing and you'll get use to it.

But it's the customization that really puts it over the top. You can program every single action the controller can do, and save it on the controller for use elsewhere. I have yet to be disappointed by the device.
I tried it in the store and it felt stiff and clicky. Is it better in use?
Which was stiff? The joystick and buttons work fine for me. Pressing down on the touch pads feel clicky though.

The touchpads were clicky and felt cheap. I am seeing good reviews here, maybe it's just my expectation or idea of quality. I like the paddles and how it feels in my hand, maybe it's better when playing games?

Yes, you're right. They feel that way to me too, but I use them infrequently so I don't deal with it much. Certain games like third person adventure games always use it, but technically you could bind that to the paddle buttons underneath the controller.

But that's the only thing that feels cheap. The triggers are very nice. They have the two stage click that feels smooth, and you can bind the second stage to be something else or a different style of input. It's really nice.
I love it. It's taken a while to get used to but I'm hoping more people use it so other companies can improve even further on the design.

I just got mine about a month ago and I absolutely love it. It has the most precise touchpads I've ever used, and though the buttons are smallish you get used to them really quick. Almost all the weight is in the fat palm lobes, which when you grip it feels perfect. Using it in an FPS with no controller support is great. I wouldn't use it in a competitive or twitch based online FPS, but I've used it in nearly everything else I own and it's amazing. It takes some getting used to, but once you get acclimated the "Ol' Standby" 360 pad feels dated as fuck.

It's awesome to see how many people love the controller. The customizability when you get really into the settings is INSANE. you can even rotate how the touch pad interprets your swipe movements so you never have to worry about being perfectly vertical or horizontal. its really a piece of art and not only does it function as a controller it functions better than any controller so far. My only gripe is that no D pad makes it kinda shoddy for old school emulation.
